name: 09 — Single LLM failure does not kill the session
description: Iteration 1's mock LLM call throws (simulating a transient 5xx from the provider). The orchestrator must emit an llm_error SSE event but NOT a session error, increment consecutiveLLMFailures (still below the 3-strike kill threshold), and proceed to iteration 2. Iteration 2 returns a normal completed response. Final session status is 'completed' and exactly one blackboard entry exists — the one written in iteration 2. The absence of an iteration_complete event after the failed iteration is intentional: the orchestrator returns early on LLM failure without emitting iteration_complete for that iteration.
prompt: Briefly note something for me; expect a transient provider hiccup on the first try.
